GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Slow Out 1 Lengths Settled Down 6th 4 Lengths Two Wide with cover To The Turn 5th @ 200m but now flat and didn't finish off (b/off) # big $$$ bled

Hampered at the start and Settled Down 7 Lengths 3 Wide , Moved Up to 3.5 Lengths 3 Wide turning, Lost Ground in straight. (Blinkers AGAIN) [Stewards: Bumped and hampered at the start. Raced keenly whilst being restrained.] # always Wide
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Bumped and hampered at the start by REJOICED which began awkwardly. Raced keenly whilst being restrained. Raced wide for the majority.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped only fairly & Settled Down 2.5 Lengths on fence, raced tight for some distance at 900m, trailed 3 Lengths rail turning, Lost Ground in straight. (Winkers OFF AGAIN) # Had its chances
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: For some distance passing the 900m, raced tight. Approaching the 300m steadied when disappointed for a doubtful inside run.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok Straight Out The Back 6 Lengths niggled @ 600m, couldn't quicken (b/off w/ag t/t/1st) # couldn't finish off
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Rdr reported mount raced flat and proved disappointing.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok Restrained to slot in Settled Down 7th Inside 6 Lengths off Inside x 600m 8th into Straight then flat @ 200m, couldn't finish off - # lame left hind
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Over raced in the early stages. Laid in under pressure in the home straight. A post race vet exam revealed lameness in the left hindleg. Vet clearance prior to racing again.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok Not Bustled Settled Down 6th 5 Lengths into Clear 3 Wide Turning for home immed Under Pressure , couldn't quicken couldn't finish off was duric 1st time hence supported - # good $$ slow recov.
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Laid in in the early part of the home straight. Rdr reported mount may not have appreciated track conditions. A post-race vet exam revealed a slow recovery. Going for a spell.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok Restrained from Outside hence Settled Down rear - ran on strong from 100m, laying in over final 50m - # fall, no vision
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Laid in under pressure over the final 50m. When asked about tactics, Rdr stated from wide barrier, instructed to take up a position with cover, settling at the rear-said when placed under pressure in the home straight, mare had a tendency to lay in & took some time to get balanced, however, finished the race off strongly over the final 100m-added from a better barrier, would expect mare to settle in a more forward position.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Slow Out 0.5 Lengths settled down third last fence 5 Lengths (800m), off heels nowhere to go 500 back last, still held up to 200, Through gap late, far too late # train wreck/forgive
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Began awkwardly. Steadied from heels near the 800m. Checked and shifted out passing the 600m and for a short distance after was awkwardly placed close to heels. Held up for a run from the 400m until passing the 50m.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok Ridden Along Settled Down 6th Two Wide with cover 4 Lengths out 3 Wide in Clear Turning for home 3rd x 200m, into Lead x 50m, and got it done - # perfect run/ride
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Began awkwardly, shifted in and bumped. Dislodged the bubble cheeker after the start. Race keenly in the middle stages. Laid in near the 150m.
